headlines.description: Jürgen Klopp was denied a win in his first game in charge of Germany as his former Liverpool player Cody Gakpo secured a 1-1 draw for the Netherlands in stoppage time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Xavi, Klopp debut as Netherlands draw with Germany on Gakpo goal

headlines.description: Portugal edged Wales 1-0 in Lisbon to make a winning start to their UEFA Nations League campaign on what was a frustrating night for Cristiano Ronaldo.
headlines.shortLinkText: Portugal edge Wales on frustrating night for Ronaldo

headlines.description: Roberto Mancini's second spell in charge of Italy ended in a chastening 2-0 Nations League defeat in Rome as Belgium earned a deserved win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mancini's Italy return starts with Belgium defeat

headlines.description: Zinedine Zidane's first game at the helm of France resulted in a 1-0 victory over Turkey as Kylian Mbappé supplied the only goal of the Nations League fixture before promptly being replaced due to injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mbappé injury overshadows Zidane's 1st France win

headlines.description: Scotland's ramped-up second-half performance offered some cause for optimism as Sebastien Pocognoli's tenure as head coach began with a goalless draw with Slovenia in Ljubljana.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scotland held to goalless draw against Slovenia

headlines.description: England embraced the chaos but failed to see off Spain as the world champions punished Harry Kane's missed spot-kick to secure a 3-2 comeback win in Saturday's helter-skelter Nations League opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: World champs Spain beat England in Wembley thriller

headlines.description: Wales wilted in Copenhagen as a 2-0 defeat to Denmark left them bottom of their Nations League group.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wales bottom of NL group after loss in Denmark

headlines.description: Mexx Meerdink scored twice as the Netherlands beat Serbia 2-1 away in the Nations League on Sunday, giving new coach Xavi Hernándeez his first win in charge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Xavi gets 1st Netherlands win with Meerdink brace

headlines.description: Jürgen Klopp's homecoming fell flat as his first home match in charge of Germany ended with a surprise 1-0 defeat by Greece in Augsburg.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greece stun Germany as Klopp remains winless

headlines.description: Jack Moylan scored and added an assist as the Republic of Ireland beat Israel 3-0 in their controversial Nations League fixture in Debrecen, Hungary.
headlines.shortLinkText: Republic of Ireland beat Israel in controversial fixture

headlines.description: Erling Haaland's record-extending 22nd UEFA Nations League goal wasn't enough to prevent Norway from going down to a 2-1 home loss to a Portugal side missing its star man, Cristiano Ronaldo.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland scores but Ronaldo-less Portugal top Norway

headlines.description: Michael Olise produced a stunning 89th-minute winner as France overcame Belgium 1-0 in their Nations League clash in Brussels.
headlines.shortLinkText: Olise nets late winner as France edge Belgium

headlines.description: Roberto Mancini claimed his first win back in charge of Italy with a comfortable 4-1 Nations League victory over Türkiye in Bursa.
headlines.shortLinkText: Italy hit four past Türkiye as Mancini gets first win

headlines.description: Anthony Gordon and Harry Kane secured England a straightforward 2-0 win away to 10-man Czechia at the end of one of the most dramatic days in the nation's footballing history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gordon, Kane lead England past 10-man Czechia

headlines.description: New Scotland boss Sebastien Pocognoli endured a demoralising Hampden debut as his 10-man side were dismantled 3-0 by sure-footed Switzerland in the Nations League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scotland routed by Swiss in Pocognoli's home debut

headlines.description: Lamine Yamal fired a double as Spain cruised to a 4-1 win against Croatia in Seville on Tuesday to open up a three-point lead at the top of their Nations League group.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spain extend record unbeaten run to 40 with Yamal double

headlines.description: Portugal displayed no ill effects from the drama surrounding Cristiano Ronaldo as the UEFA Nations League holders brushed aside Denmark on Thursday to maintain their perfect record in this season's competition.
headlines.shortLinkText: Portugal shrug off Ronaldo drama to sweep aside Denmark

headlines.description: New Germany manager Jürgen Klopp got his first win with a 2-0 Nations League victory over Serbia in Munich on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wirtz scores as Klopp gets first win with Germany

headlines.description: Wales ended their long wait for a Nations League A win by beating Norway 2-1 in Cardiff.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wales beat 10-man Norway for 1st win in 2026

headlines.description: Alessandro Bastoni spoiled Zinedine Zidane's homecoming as France head coach as Italy earned a 1-1 draw in their Nations League clash in Paris.
headlines.shortLinkText: Italy rally to frustrate France in Zidane's home debut

headlines.description: England produced one of their most dominant performances in recent years as they dismantled Croatia in a stunning 7-0 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: England put on a show in 7-0 thrashing of Croatia

headlines.description: Sassuolo forward Kieron Bowie broke his Scotland duck with a wonder strike to set Sébastien Pocognoli on the way to his first victory as head coach on a night of landmarks in North Macedonia for the dominant visitors.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sébastien Pocognoli gets first Scotland win

headlines.description: Lamine Yamal scored a superb early goal as world champions Spain beat Czechia 3-1 in Oviedo to maintain their perfect start in Nations League Group A3.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yamal, Rodri inspire Spain win over Czechia

headlines.description: Greece are level on points with Nations League Group A2 leaders the Netherlands after drawing 0-0 with Germany in Thessaloniki.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greece frustrate Klopp's Germany in goalless draw

headlines.description: Gonçalo Ramos is helping Portugal to forget all about Cristiano Ronaldo as he fired Portugal to a 2-1 win over Norway on Sunday to keep the Portuguese perfect in Group A4 with four wins from four games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Portugal stay perfect without Ronaldo in Norway win

headlines.description: Troy Parrott's first-half penalty was cancelled out after the break as the Republic of Ireland played out a 1-1 Nations League draw with Israel behind closed doors in Serbia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Israel cancel out Troy Parrott's penalty to hold Ireland to draw

headlines.description: Wales suffered a 1-0 Nations League defeat to Denmark as Rasmus Højlund struck from the penalty spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Højlund punishes Danny Ward error to sink Wales

headlines.description: Zinedine Zidane's France belatedly turned on the style as late goals from substitutes Désiré Doué, Ryan Cherki and two from Michael Olise saw them come from behind to beat Belgium 4-1 in the UEFA Nations League.
headlines.shortLinkText: France stun Belgium with four late goals

headlines.description: Pio Esposito's late goal sealed a hard-earned win over Türkiye in Bologna and continued Italy's improvement under returning head coach Roberto Mancini.
headlines.shortLinkText: Italian renaissance continues with runaway win over Türkiye

headlines.description: Spain preserved a 2½-year unbeaten streak by rallying to beat Croatia 2-1 thanks to a clutch second-half double from super-sub Mikel Merino on Tuesday in Split.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spain rally to beat Croatia, unbeaten run up to 43

headlines.description: England captain Harry Kane marked his record-equalling 125th appearance with a brace as Thomas Tuchel's men all but secured their place in the Nations League knockouts with a 3-0 win against Czechia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kane leads England past Czechia in record outing

headlines.description: Sebastien Pocognoli's first camp as Scotland head coach ended with a grim and damaging 2-1 Nations League defeat at home to Slovenia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scotland end window with home loss to Slovenia
